prompt: Bounded static/mock Relay task. This is a corrective replacement for the unaccepted PR #45; start ONLY from the exact target branch/head/tree above and do not depend on the PR #45 branch. Implement a Relay-side Core compatibility adapter without importing or modifying src/phase0_core. Critical semantic requirement: Core CaseRunner persists collect() bytes and then parses those bytes directly as the Provider Response JSON. Therefore collect() MUST return rawResponse.encode('utf-8') exactly, where rawResponse is the underlying Relay bridge result's string Provider Response. It MUST NOT json.dumps() the Relay wrapper dict containing stdout/rawResponse/correlation_id. Missing or non-string rawResponse must fail closed. Validate provider_id is a non-empty string at adapter construction. prepare() must deepcopy caller input, inject this adapter provider_id when provider_id is omitted, and reject a conflicting explicit provider_id instead of silently switching identity. Preserve existing bridge/dispatcher semantics; do not edit src/relay/bridge.py or dispatcher.py. Add focused tests proving: provider_id validation; omitted provider_id is injected; conflicting provider_id rejected; caller payload not mutated; collect returns exact rawResponse bytes with no Relay wrapper keys; missing/non-string raw fails closed; abort delegates; classify(bytes) is fail-closed on malformed bytes and never claims live execution/delivery/retry/fallback. Include a test bridge/subclass whose rawResponse is a complete Phase0 Provider Response-shaped JSON so json.loads(adapter.collect(...)) yields the response object itself, not {stdout, rawResponse,...}. No live/provider/network/auth/API/billing/settings/GitHub runtime writes. retry=0, fallback disabled. Run PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v, python -m compileall -q src tests, and git diff --check.
